admission.justification: A header that hides a failed read or shows it as a smaller truth would make an index problem invisible; the one-line header that names it prevents that costly misreading.

applicability: The single-line header of the Knowledge reader at every width.
conditions: Repository, memory tree and the record lookup render on the left.
The memory and code tree identifiers and the pin render small on the right.
An index problem is still shown in full at the top of the document.
exclusions: The document body and the tree pane.
statement: Repository, memory selection and record lookup stay in one header line, while index problems remain fully visible in the document.
